title: RACP leadership dispute lands in court amid bullying allegations
note: Royal Australasian College of Physicians (RACP) faces a Fair Work stop-bullying claim filed by president-elect Dr Sharmila Chandran against current president Professor Jennifer Martin. Allegations include exclusion, intimidation, and governance failings. The dispute highlights psychosocial and cultural risks within professional associations.

title: JLL apologises for cultural and leadership failures after sexual harassment probe
note: JLL publicly apologised and admitted to cultural and leadership failings following an external investigation into its handling of sexual harassment allegations within its Australian business. An independent review by Clyde & Co found serious issues including inappropriate behaviours, poor executive decision-making, and non-compliance with established policies and protocols. JLL has committed to significant reforms.

title: ‘Reputational damage’: Sacked JLL agents hit back with federal lawsuit
note: Former JLL Australia industrial agents Peter Blade and Greg Pike have commenced proceedings in the Federal Court and with the Fair Work Commission, alleging flawed process and reputational harm following their 12 Oct dismissals. JLL disputes the claims. Allegations only; no findings.

title: One in three Australians sexually harassed at work: study
note: A report by Burke Mangan Lawyers finds that one in three Australians (41% of women, 26% of men, 67% of non-binary) have experienced sexual harassment at work. Only one in five incidents are reported; particular risk in male-dominated, younger-staffed industries. Systemic under-reporting and weak consequences highlight culture and control issues.
